content_review: Mike Usher's MATH 8210 Fall 2011 lecture notes. The extracted portion develops smooth manifolds from coordinate-free multivariable calculus through partitions of unity, tangent and cotangent bundles, vector fields, differential forms, the exterior derivative, pullback, and de Rham cohomology. Thirteen numbered exercises are interspersed as course-note exercises; they do not turn the document into a qualifying-exam or standalone problem-set source.
resource_route: wiki/topology/resources/books-notes.md already lists a distinct, larger Mike Usher Fall 2011 differential-geometry notes PDF (assets/attachments/Usher DG Notes.pdf, different SHA-256). That resource page is concurrent MM state, so this intake does not rewrite it or add a redundant second Usher-notes link.
